description: This script generates a MIME type configuration for the lighttpd web server based on the system's /etc/mime.types and some additional mappings. It categorizes file extensions with their corresponding MIME types, handling conflicts and special cases, and outputs a configuration snippet for lighttpd.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Assigns a MIME type to a file extension and stores both original and lowercase variant mappings.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds or updates MIME type mappings for a given extension, resolving conflicts according to specific rules.

methods.name: print_type
methods.description: Outputs the mapping of a file extension to its MIME type, appending charset info for text types when applicable.

search-terms: file extension to MIME type mapping
